Last Update: 2026/9/12
The most recent schedule of entrance exams
The Entrance Examination Schedule B, 2027 will be held on the following dates. For other dates and details, please be sure to check the Briefing Sessions page as well as the Application Guidelines and Applicant's Guide.
Application Period:
November 11 to 17, 2026
Written Examination (Specialty):
January 26, 2027
Oral Examination:
BI on January 27, CB/MS on January 28, 2027
Announcement of successful candidates:
February 18, 2027
Notes
Beginning with the AY2025 Entrance Examination for Schedule A, if you do not hold a Japan citizenship and if you do no reside in Japan when you apply to Graduate School of Frontier Sciences, UTokyo, you may not be able to enroll in the semester immediately after the entrance exams. See the site below for details.
Flowchart and FAQ Regarding Enrollment Timing for International Applicants: 2027 Entrance Examination (Schedule B)
Overview of the Entrance Examination Schedule for this academic year
The admissions schedule for Department of Computational Biology and Medical Sciences is as follows. For details of the schedule, please be sure to check the Briefing Sessions page as well as the Application Guidelines and Applicant's Guide.
Entrance examinations are held twice a year, which are called Schedule A and Schedule B. Applicants may take the examination more than once.
